text:
Ivy (support): pinging eng, started getting a flurry of 429s ~21:32 UTC from multiple hosted customers. Customers say they didn't change traffic. example tenant t-5582 posted logs showing 20-30% of calls 429-ing. :sos:
Clara (support): zendesk examples attached. customers mostly in us-west. some report slow tails before 429s.
Hector (eng-runtime): looking at rate-limiter telemetry. I see token_bucket.capacity suddenly reduced to near-zero for many tenants at 21:31. refill_rate stayed same but burst_capacity is 0.
Rina (eng-sre): any recent commit touching limiter config or loader? Ops-Bot shows a config push at 21:27 by @hector: commit a9b2f1 that introduced "global_route_limits" feature flag.
Hector (eng-runtime): that feature flips route-level overrides to be combined multiplicatively with tenant bursts. bug: the merge used default_multiplier=0.0 for routes without explicit multiplier, effectively zeroing burst capacity when a route GUID wasn't present. snippet from the new merge code (sanitized):
```go
func mergeBurst(tTenant, rRoute float64) float64 {
  return tTenant * rRoute // rRoute defaults to 0 if missing
}
```
Hector (eng-runtime): should've used 1.0 default, not 0.0.
Tom (oncall): rolling back the feature flag for hosted pool now. starting rollback. Ops-Bot: rollback in progress (triggered by @tom).
Clara (support): customers asking for repro. here's a small harness they can run to surface the issue quickly:
```
# run 15 parallel lightweight requests
for i in {1..15}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"x"}' &
done; wait
# if you see >5 429s within 10s, you're hitting the limited burst case
```
Hector (eng-runtime): observed that only hosted route nodes pulled the new routing map; dedicated didn't. prioritized rollback to minimize customer impact. rollback complete, metrics show burst_capacity restoring within ~40s.
Rina (eng-sre): quick mitigations we applied: 1) feature-flag rollback 2) hotpatch in memory to treat missing route multiplier as 1.0 3) add alert on sudden token_bucket.capacity drop (>50% delta) 4) tag affected tenant list for support outreach.
Ivy (support): drafting customer messages now with timeline and interim workaround. customers asking if failed requests were billable.
Finance (billing): policy: server-side throttles for platform config issues are non-billable; we'll issue credits for the incident window after verifying request logs. please attach affected tenant ids and time-range.
Amir (product): need post-incident action items and estimates on ETA for fix. also request we publish a status update.
Hector (eng-runtime): root cause: runtime merge function mistakenly used zero-value for optional route multiplier. missing unit tests and no schema default in the config store allowed this to ship. fix is trivial but we need stronger safety around feature flags that change enforcement math.
Rina (eng-sre): post-incident actions: - add unit tests for mergeBurst with missing route data - add schema defaults in config store for route multipliers - require canary rollout (1%) with smoke parallel requests for any change touching rate limiting math - add a deploy gating job that runs a small synthetic burst test against hosted nodes - update runbook to include immediate rollback steps for feature flags altering limiter math
Hector (eng-runtime): opened PR with default fix + tests. will also add a lint that rejects multiplication by uninitialized values in this area.
Tom (oncall): incident marked recovered in slack; will schedule a 45min postmortem tomorrow. leaving this thread open until postmortem link is posted. :white_check_mark:
Clara (support): I've exported affected tenants and attached zendesk tickets to the postmortem ticket. sending initial apology message to impacted customers now.
Ivy (support): please confirm whether customers should run the repro harness to validate their fix or wait for us.
Hector (eng-runtime): they can run it if they want immediate confirmation. otherwise we'll send a follow-up when fixes are deployed across all regions.
Amir (product): ensure comms include clear language about credits and what caused the issue (no customer action required).
Finance (billing): I'll queue the credits batch and ensure we exclude legitimate client-side rate limiters from auto-credit.
Rina (eng-sre): final note: adding a telemetry sanity check that raises a deploy-blocking alarm if any tenant's burst_capacity falls below 10% of baseline during rollout. closing thread once postmortem published.
